stories.title: Aguacate mexicano tiene nuevo requisito para su exportación; deberá contar con certificado laboral, ¿en qué consiste la medida?

en.title: Mexican avocado has new export requirement; must have labor certificate, what does the measure consist of?
en.summary: Mexico's labor authority announced a new mechanism requiring avocado exports to be regulated through a labor certificate system.

stories.title: SEP: Ataque en secundaria de Torreón donde asesinan a subdirectora es "reprobable"

en.title: SEP: Attack at Torreón secondary school where assistant principal is killed is "reprehensible"
en.summary: Mexico's education ministry condemned an attack at a secondary school in Torreón that resulted in a teacher's death and expressed condolences to the victim's family and school community.

stories.title: Empresa de Aguascalientes anuncia construcción de nueva planta; atraerá inversión y más empleos

en.title: Aguascalientes company announces construction of new plant; will attract investment and more jobs
en.summary: An Aguascalientes-based company announced plans to build a new manufacturing facility expected to generate investment and employment opportunities.

stories.title: SEP dará acompañamiento a alumnos tras ataque a subdirectora de secundaria en Torreón; lamenta hecho

en.title: SEP will provide support to students following attack on secondary school assistant principal in Torreón; regrets incident
en.summary: Mexico's education ministry announced it will provide institutional support to the school community affected by the attack on a secondary school administrator in Torreón.

stories.title: Ataque en secundaria de Torreón: fiscal lo relaciona con imitación de agresores de otros países; hay un contexto de desintegración familiar, dice

en.title: Attack at secondary school in Torreón: prosecutor links it to imitation of aggressors from other countries; there is a context of family disintegration, says
en.summary: A prosecutor stated that a school attack in Torreón involved bladed weapons and firecrackers rather than firearms, and linked it to imitation of attackers from abroad within a context of family breakdown.

stories.title: Empresa local VOLMEX anuncia proyecto de expansión en Aguascalientes

en.title: Local company VOLMEX announces expansion project in Aguascalientes
en.summary: VOLMEX, a local enterprise, presented an expansion project for its Aguascalientes facility to the state governor, aimed at enhancing production capacity for dumping equipment, semi-trailers, and heavy transport solutions.

stories.title: Estados Unidos blinda las Carnitas Michoacán; conceden registro oficial a la receta tradicional

en.title: United States protects Carnitas Michoacán; grants official registration to traditional recipe
en.summary: The United States has granted official registration to the traditional recipe for Carnitas Michoacán, providing protected status for this regional specialty.

stories.title: COCENA pide que Certificado Laboral en el aguacate evite simulación y garantice empleos reales

en.title: COCENA requests that Labor Certificate in avocado avoid simulation and guarantee real jobs
en.summary: An organization requested that the labor certification for avocado exports serve as a genuine guarantee of employment compliance rather than mere formality, with officials confirming the certificate is a non-transferable document verifying labor obligations.

stories.title: Christa Pike, mujer condenada a muerte en EU, está en "estado crítico" tras ejecución fallida

en.title: Christa Pike, woman sentenced to death in US, in 'critical condition' after failed execution
en.summary: A woman sentenced to death in the United States is in critical condition following a failed execution and is receiving medical care, according to her attorney.

stories.title: La marca Carnitas Michoacán ya está registrada en Estados Unidos

en.title: Carnitas Michoacán brand is now registered in the United States
en.summary: The Carnitas Michoacán brand has received trademark registration from the US Patent and Trademark Office, protecting its use in the United States and strengthening the identity of a prominent Mexican regional product.

stories.title: Ataque en secundaria de Torreón: Muere subdirectora y detienen a dos exalumnos

en.title: Attack at Torreón secondary school: Vice principal dies and two former students detained
en.summary: Two 18-year-old brothers were detained after an attack at a secondary school in Torreón that resulted in one vice principal's death and injuries to three other people.

stories.title: Irrumpen en secundaria en Torreón y matan a subdirectora

en.title: Two youths break into secondary school in Torreón and kill vice principal
en.summary: Two 18-year-old individuals entered a secondary school in Torreón and killed the school's vice principal, according to the Coahuila prosecutor's office.

stories.title: Liderazgo educativo desde el Tec de Monterrey

en.title: Educational leadership from Tec de Monterrey
en.summary: Javier Reyes Altamirano, rector of the University of Massachusetts Amherst, built his career on mentorship and social focus to transform higher education internationally.

stories.title: Tu forma de viajar está a punto de cambiar

en.title: Your way of traveling is about to change
en.summary: TripQuency is a new travel service that allows customers to select the specific benefits they want for their trips.

stories.title: La última milla del nearshoring: mover el capital entre fronteras

en.title: The last mile of nearshoring: moving capital across borders
en.summary: Growing trade between Mexico and the US requires faster and more transparent business-to-business payments to prevent capital from being stuck between borders.

stories.title: Usuarios abandonan el seguro de gastos médicos y buscan atención en el servicio público de salud

en.title: Users abandon medical expense insurance and seek care in public health services
en.summary: Rising insurance premiums and medical inflation are straining household and business budgets, limiting access to private hospitals.

stories.title: Cancún y Veracruz se posicionan para atraer data centers, si logran superar la barrera del suministro eléctrico

en.title: Cancún and Veracruz position themselves to attract data centers, if they overcome the electrical supply barrier
en.summary: Cancún and Veracruz are competing to attract data centers, leveraging coastal advantages from submarine cable stations. Both cities face challenges with electrical supply and infrastructure similar to other regions pursuing data center investment.
